name: Joud Bird
source: JOUD 26 PRINT FILE (TONE, Joud Campaign 2026) and the Talaatna reel

decisions.character: One bird with two outfits. The game uses the round outfit (glasses + flowered vest).
decisions.tail: Small peach feathered tail, taken from the slim-outfit side view of the same bird
decisions.vest_back: Plain vest colour with the green collar continuing around (not shown in any reference; approved assumption)
decisions.head_tuft: Left out (appears in one poster close-up only)

silhouette: One big round body with a smaller round head merged on top (no neck); two long wings spread to the sides in flight

face.beak: tiny dark squiggle between and just below the lenses
face.glasses: two large round wire lenses with a bridge; built in code, not generated

palette_note: Sampled from the print file as screen RGB. The flying poster draws the vest pinker (#F8C2A9); the board version above is the reference.

outfit.front: green centre line with four red-brown buttons; two pink flowers with yellow centres on green stems with leaves

wings: cream, ending in solid peach scalloped tips
style: flat matte colours, toy-like, no outlines, no shine
must_keep: round cream body with merged round head
built_in_code: legs (thin black cylinders, three toes, trailing back)

textures.normal: 1024 WebP (keep: hides low-poly facets on the belly)

model.units: model units, centred at the origin; body sphere radius ~0.6; wingspan 1.90; height 1.39
model.game_scale_note: 0.2 makes the body radius ~0.12 m to match the collision circle; wingspan becomes ~0.38 m
model.facing: +Z is the front (face, vest). Rotate about Y by about -50 to -60 degrees so it faces the flight direction (left) while the player still sees the vest and face. A pure side view hides the outfit and shows the near wing edge-on.
model.glasses_hint: Two torus rings centred just in front of each eye (z ~0.26), ring radius ~0.065, tube ~0.008, colour #555655, each turned ~15-20 degrees about Y to follow the head's curve; short bridge between them above the beak at y ~0.54. Add as children of the model so they inherit scale and rotation.
model.legs_hint: Two thin black cylinders from under the body (y ~-0.65, x ~+-0.15), trailing backwards and down, with three short toes each.
missing_vs_brief: tail (not generated; optional, invisible at game distance)
